comment: Pinned Ed25519 public keys that sign Windows update manifests (UPDATE.json), by key id: raw 32-byte keys in base64url. Only the owner adds one (issues/9-later/NF-9B-in-app-updates.md). store-2026-1 is the store key for now; a separate update key is added, and CI signs with it, before the first release that carries the updater.
